taus.name: taus
taus.definition: [t for t in get_taus(event) if t['pt'] > 20 and abs(t['eta']) < 2.3]

jets.name: jets
jets.definition: [j for j in get_jets(event) if j['pt'] > 30 and abs(j['eta']) < 4.7]

bjets.name: bjets
bjets.definition: [o for o in event['objects'] if o['type'] == 4 and int(o['btag']) == 1]
